youtube.description:
At Corellium, we changed what's possible so you can build what's next for the next generation of smart devices – iOS, Android, and Arm.

Our powerful platform provides teams with unmatched tools to virtualize Arm-based devices, enabling advanced mobile app testing, security research, and IoT device modeling. 

Corellium MATRIX™ takes mobile app security testing to the next level by allowing you to automate security testing for iOS and Android apps. By automating routine tests, security professionals can reclaim up to 75% of the time spent on mundane, repetitive tasks freeing up their time for more advanced security testing where their skills really shine.
